offering_description.value: Designs, manufactures and sells single-use medical devices for hospitals and healthcare providers. Products support vascular access, interventional cardiology and urology, surgical, anesthesia and respiratory care. Sold mainly to hospitals through direct sales forces and distributors.

primary_products.value: vascular access catheters; interventional cardiology and peripheral devices; surgical ligation and closure devices; urology catheters and devices; anesthesia and respiratory products

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, clinics, ambulatory surgery centers and healthcare providers, group purchasing organizations; B2G: government and public hospitals, military health systems

end_markets.value: healthcare; hospitals; interventional cardiology; urology; surgery; critical care

revenue_model.value: product sales: single-use and disposable medical devices sold to hospitals and healthcare providers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures medical devices from purchased materials and components, sold to hospitals and distributors; brand owner: owns branded medical device product lines marketed to clinicians

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia-Pacific and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: vascular access, interventional, surgical, urology, anesthesia and respiratory devices sharing hospital customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales force selling to hospitals and group purchasing organizations; distributors / dealers: medical product distributors, especially in international markets

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices requiring FDA clearance or approval, EU MDR and other national regulators

notes: Teleflex has been restructuring (divestitures of some businesses); portfolio details may have changed.
